message: So, the other night I was making dinner and I accidentally set off the smoke alarm. 😅 My family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree! Everyone was checking in, offering to bring over takeout, and reminding me to double-check the escape plan. It was a hilarious reminder that even in the chaos, it's good to have a plan and keep those escape routes fresh in our minds. Who knew a little smoke could spark such a fun family moment?
